Not a defect; a risk recorded in the body: loadIssueNodes finds an issue's last change by reading its events backwards on (issue_key, seq), and no partial index matches that type list. It is unmeasured on large issues; in practice the daemon's status writes are issue.updated events, so the scan stays short.
